formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (5); no reinforcing strong anionic.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (10, prominent), with Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein (6) and Glycerin (9). C2 not met (no silicone, payload lipid or pearlizing route).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Single polymer and a hydrolyzed protein; a cleansing-led low reading is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one cationic guar (10) and a hydrolyzed wheat protein (6) against an effective buffered SLES chassis; no silicone, lipid or film former.

persistence.rationale: Light polymer and hydrolyzed protein are weakly retained.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: One light polymer plus a hydrolyzed protein with moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families present, but they are one guar and a hydrolyzed (small, weakly film-forming) protein; no silicone, lipid or film former converges and the SLES chassis offsets light residue.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: nonspecific (single hydrolyzed protein is not repair_supported; Biotin and rice extract are marketing-type actives). Low weight would be compatible with volume if claimed.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met only via prominent Glycerin (9) humectant route; no comfort route.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.
